qr_scan_handler.details: Inward scan updates material/rack stock properly, but leaves qr_codes.status as 'unused'.

transactions_table.details: Transactions logged correctly with material_id, transaction_type='inward', quantity, user_id.

materials_table.details: Material inventory stock incremented accurately from 4500.00 to 4700.00 KG.

racks_table.details: Rack capacity incremented accurately from 4500.00 to 4700.00 KG.

rack_inventory_table.details: Trigger automatically synced racks changes to rack_inventory current_capacity.

occupancy_calculation.details: Occupancy percentage formula (quantity / max_capacity * 100) evaluated to 0.00% under 999999999 KG max capacity limit.

digital_twin_api.details: Rack capacity matches database, but nested materials list returns empty due to JOIN qr_codes WHERE status='used'.

rack_view_api.details: Rack View APIs return accurate current_stock and occupancy percentages matching database state.

frontend_rendering.details: React UI renders rack capacity, occupancy gauges, and live movement feeds cleanly.

overall_summary.primary_failure_point: QR Code Status Lifecycle & Digital Twin Material Lookup
overall_summary.root_cause: autoStore does not update qr_codes.status to 'used', causing Digital Twin JOIN query to return empty materials array for the rack.
overall_summary.recommended_fix: In autoStore, add UPDATE qr_codes SET status='used', rack_code=? WHERE barcode_id=? to maintain QR lifecycle consistency.
